notes.title: Factions and upcoming Demo update
notes.notes: [p]Hey people,[/p][p][/p][p]Alex 13 here.[/p][p][/p][h1]Demo update[/h1][p]First of all - the Demo will be updated next Friday. Expect more polish and QoL features, a bunch of new enemy types, and a Faction system.[/p][p][/p][h1]Factions[/h1][p]All enemies in ToP are divided into Factions like Outlaws, Hordes, Undead etc. [/p][p]When the Dungeon is generated, the game now determines which Faction will primarily inhabit it. No more mixed salad of Orc Warlords (Hordes), Wizards (Outlaws) and Rats (Monsters). There will now be consistency with some randomness - so if it's an Undead-inhabited dungeon, expect lots of Undead with occasional representatives of other factions. [/p][p][/p][p]Faction enemies differ in their typical resistances - Undead, for example, have high resistance to Dark damage but no resistance at all to Light damage.[/p][p][/p][p]Since the game will now show the type of dungeon inhabitants, it's another decision making layer for you, adventurers. Is your party Dar magic heavy? Don't go fight undead! Full of Paladins and Clerics? Yes, you will crush them![/p][p][/p][h1]Other stuff[/h1][p]The last map is coming into shape pretty well - and it's my favorite in terms of atmosphere. I love dark crypts, you know.[/p][p]A bunch of new high-level spells are implemented, so more tools to play with in the full game. [/p]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo Update
notes.notes: [p]Hey,[/p][p][/p][p]Alex 13 here. We're participating in the Steam Next Fest, so here's the new build.[/p][p]The game is in quite a good state already, so we've focused on performance, QoL, and balance. [b]But new content is here as well![/b][/p][p][/p][h1]What's new[/h1][h2]Content[/h2][h3]Classes[/h3][p]4 new classes with their respective Class Abilities:[/p][list][*][p]Arcanist - that's a Sorc, with something like Magic Missiles, a Mana Shield, and TONS of spell damage;[/p][/*][*][p]Death Knight - inspired by a particular hero from the Warcraft universe, this is a two-handed weapons-focused tank with a casting capabilities of a dark kind. Can freeze enemies; [/p][/*][*][p]Heretic - a hybrid warrior/caster focused on Curses and utilizing this debuff to deal significant damage. Does AOE on higher levels;[/p][/*][*][p]Bard - a jack of all trades. Can, to some extent, heal, buff, debuff; deal melee, ranged, and spell damage. Sings his or her songs. It's a Bard, after all. Abilities are a song to buff and a song to debuff.[/p][/*][/list][p]Currently there are 12 Classes available in the Demo, of 35 in the full game.[/p][h3]Races[/h3][p]4 new races:[/p][list][*][p]Freeman - inspired by one of the main LOTR characters that live long enough to get good at kicking ass;[/p][/*][*][p]Dark Elf - your typical cruel pointy-ears-guys. Loves dark magic, assassinations, and making others suffer;[/p][/*][*][p]Gnome - DND fans will feel right at home with this one, as well. Those lil guys make good wizards;[/p][/*][*][p]Goblin - quite a gimmick race that will have a class custom-tailored for them in the full game. For now they are just a squishy green-skinned bois.[/p][/*][/list][h3]New Difficulty Level with some surprises[/h3][p]We've unlocked the Champion Difficulty and raised the Demo Level Cap from 12 t0 15. This is the first time you'll be able to get surprised by mobs getting new abilities as they level up. No more spoilers.[/p][p]Some buildings can now be upgraded further. [/p][h3]A new enemy[/h3][p]He's Da Boss (a mini-boss actually).[/p][h3]New warrior archetype skills[/h3][p]All warrior-meta classes now know Taunt, Block, and Parry Abilities. So they now have a bit more buttons to press :)[/p][p][/p][h2]QoL and other stuff[/h2][list][*][p]Expect +5 average FPS due to some dark under the hood magery;[/p][/*][*][p]Better damage indicators;[/p][/*][*][p]Better explanation for the Skills and Mastery systems;[/p][/*][*][p]Some balance touches here and there;[/p][/*][*][p]Arena on Town Streets map is now chance-based and not an 'every time I suffer' event;[/p][/*][*][p]This Arena is now a bit easier overall;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Item icons changed from AI-generated to what our artist created;[/b][/p][/*][*][p] Updated the in-game Roadmap;[/p][/*][*][p]Changed all tooltips from the default UE graphics to our own background images. They look better now;[/p][/*][*][p]Some Level Design/Art improvements here and there;[/p][/*][*][p]Alphabetically sorted the classes available for each race in the Character Creation scree;[/p][/*][*][p]All new characters now know their respective Beginner Class Abilities, no need to buy them;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved the item tooltips behavior in the Inventory screen, moved Item Comparison to Hold Left Shift;[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Improved the Hit Percentages indicator behavior;[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked melee attack ranges for mobs and player characters;[/p][/*][*][p]Movement will now disable cursor mode;[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed “!“ above tavern when all rewards claimed;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed AoE damage indicator triggering on not damage events;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed UObject limit crash in town widgets;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed character autoswitch sometimes not working;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed item tooltips intersecting item button;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some issues with Graphics settings;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed “Apprentice” prefix permanently reducing item required level;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed “of revenge“ suffix not doing anything.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Save compatibility[/h1][p]Nothing critical - you can continue playing your old save. But it's still [b]recommended[/b] to start fresh. [/p][p]To do this, go to Options -> Misc -> Delete Save.[/p][p][/p][p]Have fun playing the game! [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks,[/p][p]13, DDG team and our pets. [/p][p][/p][p]13, out.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Development update #7
notes.notes:
Hi, Alex 13 here, with a regular update.

In a party-based RPG where fun comes from the mechanical depth, Classes have to stand out and differ. ToP's Classes already provide their rosters of skills and stat bonuses. In the future, we'll be adding 4 spell-like Abilities per Class. But for now, we've focused on adding meaningful Class Skills to further their differentiation.

Besides 33 existing Skills, we've added 35 new ones - one per Class.  Many of them are pure stat bonuses, but we also have more intricate stuff.

A few examples:
[list]
[*] Bard's Aura that gives a bonus to Attack to all party members.
[*] Sage's Aura that gives a bonus to all Resistances to all party members.
[*] Shaman's Triggered Cast of Lightning Bolt on Melee Attack.
[*] A Heretic is a high-risk / high-reward Class - they can Curse both allies and enemies with any action.
[*] Druid gives stat bonuses to Summons.
[*] Twilight Cleric gets alternating bonuses to Spell Damage and Spell Healing after casting a Healing and Damage spell, correspondingly.
[*] Goblin Magus (yes, only Goblins can get this Class) have free cast options but can miscast a spell - and hit their own party with, for example, a Fireball.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101965/70adc6162ce8c823a39e9bd16054f2f04c76ed94.png[/img]

Other stuff from this Sprint:
[list]
[*] A few new spells.
[*] New map finalized - Monastery.
[*] All Item bases have been created.
[*] Firearms weapon type added.
[*] Mage Weapons weapon type is now Ranged and makes pew-pew with magical energy.
[*] Added Resource pickable objects to speed your Town development.
[/list]

Thanks for reading.

13, out

Hi,

Alex '13' here with a regular update. We've finished Sprint 26. 

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*] Mob stats scaling reworked. Making mobs scale the same way as player characters was a mistake. It made the system too complex and unpredictable. Now we have overrides for main stats that we can easily control.
[*] Mobs can now scale to Lvl 40 while for the player the level cap is 35. This is for the highest difficulty to be really tough.
[*] Town: general building mechanics (requirements, costs, unlocks)
[*] Town: Guilds UI reworked
[*] Towns: constructing Embassies and Guilds unlocks new races and classes
[*] New map progress (about 40% done) - Monastery
[*] 10 new spells
[*] Various bugfixes
[*] New bugs :)
[/list]

We're going to rename the game soon. Project MML is a working title, it stands for 'Might and Magic-like'. But we need a proper title, an we think we've come up with something great!

notes.title: Development update #3
notes.notes:
Hi,

Alex '13' here. From now on I'm going to post here each 2 weeks. 

Our development is divided into milestones - usually 3 months long, and sprints - always 2 weeks long. Since my last post here, we've completed the first sprint of our new Milestone - Town. As usual for our team, the first sprint of a new MS is focused on processing the feedback gathered from the playtests (currently internal, but public ones are coming). fixing non-critical bugs and overall not allowing the technical debt to snowball. Which helps in keeping the team and the development cycle healthy.
[h1]The next MS 
[/h1]
We plan the following:

[list]
[*] Town building
[*] Crafting
[*] Stores and trading
[*] 3 new maps
[*] 20+ new spells
[*] 4 new classes
[*] Some QoL
[*] Balance overhaul
[*] A simple in-game video tutorial
[/list]
[h1]Sprint 25 changelog[/h1]
In no particular order :)
[list]
[*] Update the Chest level
[*] Rework the Campfire level
[*] Make lighting on Town Streets level less dark
[*] Contraband Cove light improvements
[*] Great Wall wall light improvements
[*] 2 new spells (mechanics and addition to the store)
[*] Fix: Pause the music in the shop - it overlaps with the main-level music
[*] Mob mutator chance - depending on mob level, not static
[*] Char creation: master attributes tooltips on stats during Class and Race selection
[*] Added DPS to weapon info
[*] Increase Formation Swiftness MS bonus from 15% to 25%
[*] Fix: Fire/Poison Weapon doesn't work on ranged attacks
[*] On-screen info when crosshairing a mob - a chance to hit
[*] Melee attack trace range bonus for mobs (100u default)
[*] Luck stat implementation - crit, true hit, resources, and loot bonus 
[*] Slow effect slows recovery
[*] Campfire on maps - random spawn, similar to chest. EXCEPT on the Campfire level
[*] Put music to all levels
[*] Soul Mend - updated the spell description to make it clear that it restores Energy as well
[*] Increase block effectiveness (DR)
[*] Soul mend - increase cooldown significantly
[*] Ranger's self-heal amount and CD increased
[*] Cleave - increased attack bonus
[*] All healing spells - increased CD
[*] Give a Rat caster the Fire Arrow spell for lower levels
[*] 3 more Adventure layouts
[*] Art for 3 Town buildings
[*] 3 spell VFX
[/list]

I was a guest on the WizardWorm's channel. A great guy with a cozy and interesting channel!

notes.title: Development Update #2
Development update #1
notes.notes:
Hello!

Alex '13' Uslavtsev here. Like most people in small indie teams, I do many different jobs. But mostly, I'm a producer and game designer.  Nice to meet you, dear reader. 

Today I'm here to show you our recent progress. 

As my Combat Information Cent... mmhm, excuse me, my internal progress tracker shows me - we've just passed a 40% game completion milestone. If nothing critical happens (all 7 of us are from Ukraine), we're going steadily toward the timely release. 

Recently, we updated the HUD so it looks... better. 
Before:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101965/4071473599ce972eb3e40419315197b7b8d382d1.jpg[/img]

After:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101965/a087d5d222a0df1788ee2c44d80b89981abfc3f3.png[/img]

Also, we heavily tweaked the main post-process. We tried to use it so we don't look like most of the other games (which are generally quite good games) that use the same asset packs we use. However the result didn't look good, so we removed the posterization and tweaked the color palette. Current visuals are as seen below:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101965/3196969210948f86967d6ccf2938b19feeb34257.png[/img]

On the code front, the Adventure Generation is 2 weeks from finalization - which, for such a big feature, is almost done. We already have:
- the node graph generation
- store functionality (so you can buy this-adventure-only upgrades and resources for your Town)
- all planned Boons
- mobs spawn randomization
- all types of nodes working properly
- 7 of the planned 10 Dungeon Modifiers 

The next steps are to implement the remaining 3 Damage Mods, then do the Mob Mods, then set everything up - and we're good. 

This will conclude our current milestone. I will probably do another post once the milestone is done. 

Ah, last but not least: we've updated this Steam page with new screenshots and a new trailer, which is also below:

[previewyoutube=8mr8lNTEtfc;full][/previewyoutube]

That's all for today. 
Thank you for your attention. 13, out.
